prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+8.7% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+4.2% average after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home/new_screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path/layout, finish/new_flow, finish/notification, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high in Round 1, but significantly underestimated major winners in sign_in/hint (+11.5% vs +3.0% predicted) and adoption/redesign (+22.4% vs +3.3% predicted).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +8.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -4.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +4.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 80.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 26.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Live Interactive Companion Stage Carousel Redesign: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a dynamic stage carousel with instant live preview animations and trait callouts. (why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s with an 80.2% conversion. Lessons show adoption redesigns had strong positive impact (+8.7% average).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Pet Safe Persistence Sign-In Reassurance Hint: Adds an explicit account persistence hint to the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in syncs and saves their pet securely. (why: Support mail highlighted 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in, and lessons show sign_in hint changes have a +4.2% average win rate.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Post-Adoption Desktop Launch Guidance Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop launch screen right after home introduction to guide users on finding and bringing their pet onto their screen. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% (lowest conversion) with high drop-off and support tickets regarding missing desktop pets or control confusion.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Pet Hatching Status and Tip Tracker: Enhances the waiting screen with a animated initialization status tracker, visual progress bar, and rotating desktop care tips. (why: The waiting stage (home) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating severe drop-offs before completion.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Flow: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after completing the adoption certificate rather than before pet adoption. (why: Allows users to bond with their created pet and receive their certificate before committing to account creation, increasing sign-in motivation.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Quick Control Orientation Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive post-onboarding orientation flow demonstrating how to hide, feed, and summon the pet on the desktop. (why: Support mail contained multiple confusion tickets on 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' after setup.)

scores.note: Strong historical pattern of positive results (+8.7%) for adoption redesigns addressing high time spent.
Directly backed by support tickets and a proven winning pattern (+4.2%) at minimal implementation cost.
Addresses the lowest-converting step and support complaints, but new screens carry historical friction.
Targets extreme wait times on home step, though past home changes showed negligible impact.
Reordering sign-in has previously shown negative results (-7.0%) in past testing.
Strong funnel drop-off and support mail evidence, but prior new flow test hurt conversion (-6.9%).
